**Have you checked the non-goals?**

The README lists things this plugin deliberately does not do — annotation
extraction, device sync, note generation, ruled or dot-grid pages, EPUB/MOBI
handling. Keeping it single-purpose is a design choice, so requests in those
areas are likely to be declined. If yours overlaps, say why it belongs here
rather than in a separate tool.
